newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 5.94 million barrels in the week ended May 16 to 315.81 million barrels from a revised 321.75 million barrels the prior week that was previously reported as 322.63 million, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 2.70 million barrels in the week to 253.29 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 1.92 million barrels to 98.38 million barrels from 96.46 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.11 million barrels to 32.44 million barrels.
It said gasoline production fell 150,000 barrels in the week to 7.96 million bpd from 8.11 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 837,000 barrels in the week to 197.90 million barrels from 197.06 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 97.6 percent from 96.9 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.38 million barrels to 36.44 million barrels from 37.81 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.82 million barrels from 14.74 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 41.17 million barrels from 39.67 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.83 million barrels per day from 7.57 million, API said.
